title: Ride Quality and Smoothness
summary: Feedback in this topic is mostly about the G70's ride comfort and smoothness, with many explicit compliments and a smaller set of vague or off-topic mentions that limit interpretation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews consistently praise the ride as smooth, excellent, comfortable, and enjoyable.

negative.summary: Negative reviews are sparse and the available examples focus on interior quality or broader quality and service concerns rather than a clearly described ride issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention ride quality without enough detail to confirm whether the experience was favorable, unfavorable, or merely descriptive.

limitations: The negative sample examples appear partly off-topic for ride quality, referring instead to interior quality or service, so the negative theme is not well specified.
Many undetermined fragments are too brief or incomplete to interpret beyond noting that ride quality was mentioned.
The sampled fragments are stratified examples and are not representative estimates of all G70 feedback.
